title: GlamDB native HTTP v0 wire types

int64.description: Signed 64-bit decimal; semantic range checked by the server.

receipt_version.description: Version 1: 1..10000 rows and one file. Version 2: 1..256 files, 1..25600000 rows, at most 100000 rows and 32 MiB per file in aggregate. Numeric profile bounds are checked by core and receipt readers.

decimalString.description: Exact decimal text; scale and precision are validated against the fixed schema.

dateString.description: Calendar date in Gregorian years 0001 through 9999.
